title: Coordinate isomorphism ℝ × ℝ^N ≅ ℝ^{N+1}, (t, x) ↦ (t, x_1, …, x_N)
statement: For every N ∈ ℕ there is a continuous linear equivalence L : ℝ × ℝ^N → ℝ^{N+1} with the following three properties. Here ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) = Euclid P, and ℝ × ℝ^N carries the product normed-space structure. (i) L(t, x) = (t, x_1, …, x_N), i.e. L (t, x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)), for all t ∈ ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^N. (ii) L(1, 0) = e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1. (iii) ‖L(0, x)‖ = ‖x‖ for every x ∈ ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ L : (ℝ × Euclid N) ≃L[ℝ] Euclid (N + 1), (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), L (t, x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) ∧ L (1, 0) = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∧ ∀ x : Euclid N, ‖L (0, x)‖ = ‖x‖
